notes.title: Triple Jump NES Kickstarter is live!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/morphcat-games/triple-jump-a-platformer-multi-cartridge-for-the-nes]Kickstarter campaign for our new NES multi-cartridge[/url] just started![/b]

It is a compilation of three of our platform games, namely:
[list]
[*] Micro Mages: Second Quest
[*] Spacegulls
[*] Böbl
[*] + a brand-new bonus mini game
[/list]
Here's the link: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/morphcat-games/triple-jump-a-platformer-multi-cartridge-for-the-nes]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/morphcat-games/triple-jump-a-platformer-multi-cartridge-for-the-nes[/url]

[previewyoutube=AiujX17X0Ec;full][/previewyoutube]

You can find more info on our [url=http://morphcat.de/triplejump/presskit/]Triple Jump press kit page[/url].

Sorry for not including a Steam version in the Kickstarter, there's a very good chance it will come at a later date, we just did not want to overwhelm ourselves with too many details during production.

Thanks a lot for your support and we hope you'll enjoy it!

Morphcat Games Team
